description: Ministry of Education - Cancel the Order of Transfer No, 1151, published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 12998 of 28.03.1962 made under the Assisted Schools & Training Colleges Act. w.e.f. 18.08.2017
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with the cancellation of a land extent (02 Roods and 20 Perches) for Dambuwa Buddhist Sinhala Mixed School. The order references a previous land transfer gazette and focuses exclusively on land/property matters, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4). While it mentions a minister by name, the content does not focus on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the specific land transaction.
